data: At approximately what λDIM does F1 become maximum for INFOWORD on SQuAD?

The question asks about the value of λDIM at which the F1 score becomes maximum for INFOWORD on SQuAD. From the caption, the right plot shows the F1 scores of INFOWORD on SQuAD (dev) as a function of λDIM. By analyzing the right plot, I can see that the F1 score reaches its peak around λDIM = 0.6. Therefore, the answer is approximately 0.6.
